UP Police SI DV & PST Admit Card 2026

Post Date: June 5, 2026

4:14 pm

Uttar Pradesh Police Recruitment and Promotion Board (UPPRPB), has released the DV & PST Admit Card on its official website for the recruitment of Sub Inspector and Platoon Commander posts. The DV  & PST will be conducted on 14 – 15 June 2026, and the last date to submit the application form was 11 September 2025. Candidates can check their DV & PST Admit Card using their Enrollment Number, Registration Number, or Date of Birth by logging into the portal. The direct link is provided below.

UP Police Sub Inspector SI Recruitment 2025 : Vacancy Details
Post Name No. Of Post Eligibility Criteria
UP Police Sub Inspector SI 4543
  • Candidates must hold a Graduation (Bachelor’s) degree from a recognized university or institution in India or an equivalent qualification recognized by the Government.
  • Important points : 
  • It is mandatory to upload the graduation mark sheet.
  • If the graduation degree (certificate) is not available, then the provisional graduation degree must be uploaded.
  • If the provisional graduation degree is also not available, the candidate should upload their mark sheets in its place.
  • During document verification and physical standard test, it will be mandatory for the candidates to present the original graduation degree (certificate) along with the graduation mark sheets.
  • Preference Qualification (Not Mandatory) :
  • Passing the “O” Level Computer Examination conducted by NIELIT (formerly DOEACC) or an equivalent, recognized certification
  • A minimum of two years of service in the Territorial Army.
  • A “B” certificate from the National Cadet Corps (NCC).
  • All candidates must read the official information completely before applying.

 How To Check & Download UP Police SI DV & PST Admit Card 2026 
  • Go to the official website of the
    Uttar Pradesh Police Recruitment and Promotion Board
  • On the homepage, click on:
    “Admit Card / Notifications” section
  • Find and click on:
    “Sub Inspector (SI) Admit Card 2026”
  • The admit card will open:
    • Usually in PDF format
  • Check your admit card:
    • Press Ctrl + F
    • Enter your Roll Number / Name
  • If your roll number appears, you are qualified

 

 UP Police SI Recruitment 2025 : Mode Of Selection 
  • Written Exam

  • Physical Standard Test (PST)
  • Document Verification
  • Medical Test

 UP Police SI DV / PST Admit Card 2026 : Important Question 
  • Question: Who releases the UP Police SI DV / PST Admit Card?
  • Answer: The DV / PST Admit Card is released by the Uttar Pradesh Police Recruitment and Promotion Board.
  • Question: How can I check the DV / PST Admit Card?
  • Answer: You can check it on the official website under the Results / Notifications section, usually in PDF format.
  • Question: Is login required to check the DV / PST Admit Card?
  • Answer: No, generally no login is required. You can check it directly in the PDF.
  • Question: Is this the final result?
  • Answer: Not always. It may be a stage-wise result (written exam, PET, etc.).
  • Question: What is the official website for UP Police?
  • Answer: The official website for UP Police is https://uppbpb.gov.in/Home/Index
